(V) (Errata)]] (2 August 2024, [[:File:VD-D-youveneverwonarace.gif|VD-D-youveneverwonarace.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (page 1).
